context.transcript:
Hello, Mr. Callahan.
This is Connor from Ballyway Hotel in Dublin about the company retreat you've booked with us for the first week of October.
I'm calling to confirm that you're still reserving a block of rooms for 30 people.
If the number has changed at all, please let me know.
Also, I know you were considering a welcome dinner for the first night of the meeting.
If you're still interested in that, you can view our menu options on the hotel's website.
Please give me a call back when you have a chance.
The number is 555-0101.
context.transcript_translation:
您好，卡拉汉先生。
我是来自都柏林 Ballyway Hotel 的 Connor，关于您预订我们在十月第一周的公司团建活动。
我打电话来确认您是否仍然为 30 人保留一整块房间。
如果人数有任何变化，请告诉我。
另外，我知道您考虑在会议的第一晚举办欢迎晚餐。
如果您仍然对这个感兴趣，可以在酒店的网站上查看我们的菜单选项。
请您方便的时候给我回个电话。
号码是 555-0101。
